title: Cennini face-imprint constructor with status-conditioned medium
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED, NOT SELECTED. Cennini's complete CLXIII-CLXVI account supplies a finite face-imprint process with a persistent model, cloth/ring enclosure, first mask, second fill, shell break, surviving effigy and optional metal cast. A written status condition changes the water medium while preserving process and form identity. This corrects the source family behind the unsupported Theophilus cast card without modifying that raw card.

source.work: Cennino Cennini, Trattato della pittura / Libro dell'arte, CLXIII-CLXVI
source.edition: Giuseppe Tambroni, Rome 1821, complete continuous printed chapters; source packet retains every C01-C29 content item.
source.provenance: The medieval work is witnessed by Laurenziana Plut.78.23, copied 1437. The owned wording is the 1821 edition; no direct diplomatic collation of the selected chapter folios is claimed. This supports a pre-1450 work attribution, not every 1821 spelling.

composition_contract.known_parts: An ordered process frame consumes actor, enclosure, fill, release and result arguments; reusable components preserve the current FORM and MODEL slots.
composition_contract.whole_residual: The complete residual selects MEDIUM_BY_STATUS, POUR, SET, RELEASE, REFILL, BREAK_SHELL or CAST rather than assigning a free noun to each operation.
composition_contract.entry_context: Context carries the same MODEL and first FORM through the second fill; status context selects warm rose water for the high-status branch versus warm spring/well/river water for others.
composition_contract.identity_rule: MODEL, first hardened MASK, second representation/EFFIGY and optional METAL_CAST are distinct entities. Material continuity is never inferred merely from the repeated word form or method.

operators: MEDIUM_BY_STATUS(status) -> ROSE_WATER if high_status, otherwise SPRING_OR_WELL_OR_RIVER_WATER
complete_source_plan: C01-C02: introduce imprinting as a useful likeness art and select a human model; shaving/appearance constraints remain.
C03-C08: oil and cover the model, sew the cloth, prepare toothed ring and assistant-held clearance, and pour the first casting enclosure.
C09-C11: make and place the paired perforated nose tubes; preserve model, tube and assistant roles.
C12-C15: prepare fresh sifted gypsum; use warm water; pour evenly around the face; retain the high-status rose-water versus ordinary-source-water condition and set level.
C16-C18: cut cloth, remove tubes, free the face from the first mask and preserve that form.
C19-C24: surround the same form, oil the cavity, prepare further gypsum with optional brick powder, refill, tap to remove bubbles and rest half to one day.
C25-C29: break the outer first form while preserving the new likeness, retain the effigy, list copper/metal/bronze/gold/silver/lead casting options, and require competent founders.
constructor.worked_trace: SELECT_MODEL(A,high_status) ; PREPARE_ENCLOSURE(A,CLOTH,RING,assistant) ; MEDIUM_BY_STATUS(high_status)=ROSE_WATER ; POUR(MIX_GYPSUM(gypsum,ROSE_WATER,proper),FORM1) ; PRESERVE(FORM1) ; REFILL(FORM1,new_gypsum) ; BREAK_OUTER_SHELL(FORM1) -> EFFIGY(A) ; CAST(EFFIGY,bronze). The ordinary-status rival substitutes warm spring/well/river water while preserving FORM1 and EFFIGY.
constructor.consequence: Status changes the medium branch but not model identity, enclosure ownership or the later shell-to-effigy transition. A universal-rosewater rival predicts no medium contrast; a form-fuse rival predicts that breaking the first shell destroys the result rather than leaving EFFIGY available for metal casting.
constructor.rival: R-UNIVERSAL-MEDIUM uses rose water for every model and R-FUSE merges first form, second fill and effigy into one material object. Both disagree with the source-owned condition and identity chain.
constructor.falsifier: Reject if a complete source account cannot preserve C01-C29, if the status branch changes MODEL or FORM identity, if the first form is not preserved before refill, or if shell break removes rather than releases the effigy. A target application would need a repeated process frame, a context-conditioned medium slot and an independently bound identity transition; absent these, the model is only source architecture.

predecessors.limit: Theophilus I.1-I.9 was audited and found not to contain a mold/cast sequence; this card uses the complete Cennini source that actually owns it, while leaving 436 bytes unchanged.
Theophilus named color/reference/layer relations, not status-conditioned medium and preserved-form identity.
Cato layering preserves attached plant/root state; this card concerns an artificial form, medium branch and shell/effigy transition.

dependencies: Cennini's 1821 wording, 1437 witness provenance and textual uncertainties remain explicit.

Exact dimensions and water amounts are not silently converted into target quantities.
